declarations.name: AuiButtonGroup

inputs.name: size
inputs.description: Size of the Buttons the group creates or enhances; defaults to the Button configuration.

inputs.name: buttons
inputs.description: create() only: Buttons to render. Icon-only buttons need a label.

inputs.name: attached
inputs.description: Shared borders and no inner radii; false spaces the buttons with a gap and lets horizontal groups wrap.

outputs.name: action
outputs.description: create() only: a button was activated. value defaults to the button index.

accessibility.pattern: Native buttons inside an element with role=group and an accessible name (WAI-ARIA group role). Not the APG Toolbar pattern.

limitations: Not a toolbar: there is no arrow-key roving focus. A Toolbar component is planned for that pattern.
Attached horizontal groups scroll instead of wrapping at narrow widths; buttons at the end may be off-screen until scrolled.
enhance() only considers direct child <button> elements.
